paragraphs.text: Oathkeeper is a legendary equipment on the plane of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

Oathkeeper was the famous personal daishō - a matched pair of traditionally made swords worn by samurai - of Munetsugu Takeno , the leader of the Eiganjo samurai forces of daimyo Takeshi Konda during the time of the Kami War . The sheaths of the swords had a golden color alongside a red band to hold them in place.
